title: A User-Centered Evaluation of Spanish Text Simplification

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the performance of Spanish-only monolingual models against multilingual large language models on complex word and sentence identification tasks to evaluate disparities in language-specific representation.

Qualitatively assessing regional disparities by utilizing annotators from various Spanish-speaking countries to account for dialectal variations, and noting the limitations in capturing subjective text complexity across underrepresented regional dialects.
